strategies.name: Sequential all-reduce with interleaved scaling
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all_reduce calls with element-wise scale/unscale operations between each stage, exactly as in the reference. 8 all_reduce dispatches plus 14 local kernels (7 scale, 7 unscale operations). strategies.name: Fused scale-reduce with precomputed coefficients
strategies.desc: Precomputes cumulative scale factors for all 8 stages into a single coefficient tensor, then performs all local scaling in one fused kernel before each all_reduce. 8 all_reduce dispatches but reduces local kernel launches from 14 to 8 by fusing scale and unscale into single operations per stage. Trades memory (coefficient storage) for fewer kernel dispatches.

strategies.name: Pipelined reduce-scatter plus all-gather
strategies.desc: Replaces each all_reduce with a reduce_scatter followed by all_gather, allowing overlap of communication with local scaling computation on smaller chunks. 16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but enables pipeline parallelism where scaling of gathered chunks can overlap with subsequent reduce_scatter operations. Increases collective count but exploits temporal parallelism.

strategies.name: Batched all-reduce with vectorized scaling
strategies.desc: Reshapes the scaling operations to operate on all W*S elements simultaneously using broadcasting and gather/scatter indexing, eliminating per-shard loops. Still 8 all_reduce calls but local operations become 8 single-dispatch vectorized kernels instead of W-iteration loops. Reduces local compute overhead via better memory access patterns.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction with node-local aggregation
strategies.desc:
Exploits multi-node topology by performing intra-node reductions first (fewer ranks), applying scale transformations, then inter-node reductions. For 224 ranks across multiple nodes, first does 8 stages of node-local all_reduce on subgroups, then 8 stages of cross-node all_reduce. Reduces per-collective payload size and latency when inter-node bandwidth is constrained.
